rules.title: Housing Stability Notification Act (HSNA)
rules.requirement: Landlords and foreclosing owners ending a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy must give tenants a Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources at the same time as the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal, and must send a copy to the City's Office of Housing Stability.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to all landlords/foreclosing owners intending to end a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of a unit in the City of Boston.
rules.exemptions: Residences in any hospital, skilled nursing facility or health facility; and in a non-profit facility whose primary purpose is providing short-term treatment, assistance or therapy for alcohol, drug, or other substance abuse.
rules.penalty: 1st Offense: Warning; 2nd and Subsequent Offenses: $300 per day. Violation does not halt the eviction process.
rules.citation: Boston City Ordinance Sec. 10-11.7 (Housing Stability Notification Act)
rules.quoted_span: The Ordinance applies to all landlords/foreclosing owners intending to end a tenancy or post-foreclosure occupancy of a unit in the City of Boston.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the unit is in a hospital/skilled nursing/health facility or a non-profit short-term substance abuse treatment facility

rules.title: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.requirement: A home-rule petition that, if enacted by the state legislature, would authorize the City of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections (just-cause eviction requirements).
rules.coverage_conditions: Would apply to the City of Boston if enacted; specific coverage not detailed in this passage.
rules.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.conflict_note: Bill history shows extensions and concurrences through 2024 but no indication it was enacted into law; status treated as pending.
